robots_present.title: robots.txt is published
robots_present.principle: Crawlers request /robots.txt first. Without it they assume everything is allowed but find no sitemap pointer.
robots_present.fix: Publish robots.txt at the site root with a Sitemap: line.

robots_allows_site.title: robots.txt does not block the site
robots_allows_site.principle: A stray 'Disallow: /' removes the whole site from search.

robots_sitemap.title: robots.txt points to the sitemap
robots_sitemap.principle: The Sitemap line is how crawlers without Search Console access find every page.

sitemap_present.title: sitemap.xml is published and valid
sitemap_present.principle: A sitemap lists the canonical URLs you want indexed and when they last changed.
sitemap_present.fix: Publish sitemap.xml listing every indexable page by its canonical URL.

sitemap_complete.title: Indexable page is listed in the sitemap
sitemap_complete.principle: Pages missing from the sitemap are discovered later, or not at all if they are weakly linked.
sitemap_complete.fix: Add the page's canonical URL to sitemap.xml.

sitemap_clean.title: Sitemap URL is live, indexable and canonical
sitemap_clean.principle: Listing redirects, 404s or noindex pages sends search engines mixed signals and wastes crawl budget.

status_ok.title: Page returns HTTP 200
status_ok.principle: Only pages that load can be indexed or cited.
status_ok.fix: Restore the page or remove links to it.

not_found_status.title: Missing URLs return a real 404
not_found_status.principle: Soft 404s (200 status for missing pages) get indexed as thin duplicates.
not_found_status.fix: Let GitHub Pages return 404; provide a branded 404.html.

canonical_present.title: Canonical URL declared
canonical_present.principle: GitHub Pages serves the same page at /about, /about.html and with query strings. The canonical tag says which one counts.

canonical_self.title: Canonical points to this page's own URL
canonical_self.principle: A canonical pointing elsewhere tells Google to drop this page in favour of another.
canonical_self.fix: Make the canonical the page's own absolute https URL.

viewport.title: Mobile viewport declared
viewport.principle: Google indexes the mobile version first.

internal_links_ok.title: Internal links resolve
internal_links_ok.principle: Broken internal links waste crawl paths and lose visitors.
internal_links_ok.fix: Fix or remove the broken link.

anchors_ok.title: In-page anchors exist
anchors_ok.principle: A link to #section that doesn't exist silently fails.
anchors_ok.fix: Give the target element the matching id.

not_orphan.title: Page is linked from another public page
not_orphan.principle: Pages no other page links to are hard for crawlers and people to find.
not_orphan.fix: Link to the page from the navigation, footer or a related page.

private_noindex.title: Private page is kept out of search
private_noindex.principle: Payment-gated forms and sign-in screens should never appear in search results.
private_noindex.fix: Add <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"> and keep it out of the sitemap.

title_present.title: Page has a title
title_present.principle: The title is the blue link in search results and the default share text.

title_length.title: Title is 15-65 characters
title_length.principle: Longer titles are cut off in results; very short ones waste the most important text on the page.
title_length.fix: Lead with the page's subject, end with the brand.

title_unique.title: Title is unique across the site
title_unique.principle: Duplicate titles make pages compete with each other.
title_unique.fix: Give each page its own title.

desc_present.title: Meta description present
desc_present.principle: Search engines and AI answers often quote it as the summary.
desc_present.fix: Write a 70-160 character description of what the visitor gets.

desc_length.title: Description is 70-160 characters
desc_length.principle: Too short wastes the snippet; too long is truncated.

desc_unique.title: Description is unique
desc_unique.principle: Duplicate descriptions are often ignored and rewritten by Google.

og_complete.title: Open Graph tags complete
og_complete.principle: og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url and og:type control the preview in Facebook, Instagram DMs, iMessage, Slack and LinkedIn.

og_url_canonical.title: og:url matches the canonical
og_url_canonical.principle: Shares and search should consolidate on the same URL.
og_url_canonical.fix: Use the canonical URL for og:url.

og_image_ok.title: og:image loads
og_image_ok.principle: A broken share image produces a blank preview.
og_image_ok.fix: Use an absolute, publicly reachable image URL.

twitter_card.title: Twitter/X card declared
twitter_card.principle: Without it X shows a small text-only preview.

jsonld_present.title: JSON-LD structured data present
jsonld_present.principle: Structured data states facts (who wrote this, what it costs) in a form machines don't have to guess at.
jsonld_present.fix: Add a JSON-LD block describing the page's main entity.

jsonld_valid.title: JSON-LD parses
jsonld_valid.principle: One syntax error makes the whole block invisible.

jsonld_required.title: Schema types have their required properties
jsonld_required.principle: Incomplete types (an Offer without a price, a Book without an author) are ignored for rich results.

jsonld_prices_visible.title: Structured-data prices match visible prices
jsonld_prices_visible.principle: Google penalises markup that disagrees with what visitors see. Prices must match exactly.
jsonld_prices_visible.fix: Use the exact price shown on the page.

faq_visible.title: FAQ markup matches visible questions
faq_visible.principle: FAQPage markup must mirror questions and answers that are visible on the page.
faq_visible.fix: Only mark up questions that appear on the page, word for word.

breadcrumbs.title: BreadcrumbList on inner pages
breadcrumbs.principle: Breadcrumbs show the page's place in the site in search results.

entity_home.title: Home page defines the WebSite and the author (Person)
entity_home.principle: Answer engines resolve 'who is Kay Joy Flowers' from a single, consistent Person entity with sameAs links.
entity_home.fix: Add WebSite and Person nodes with a stable @id.

entity_consistent.title: Person entity is consistent across pages
entity_consistent.principle: Conflicting names or IDs split the entity in knowledge graphs.
entity_consistent.fix: Reuse the same @id and name everywhere.

h1_single.title: Exactly one H1
h1_single.principle: The H1 is the page's headline for machines. Zero or several blurs the topic.
h1_single.fix: Use one H1 that states the page's subject.

heading_order.title: Headings don't skip levels
heading_order.principle: Answer engines use the heading outline to split a page into quotable sections.
heading_order.fix: Go H1 > H2 > H3 without skipping.

word_count.title: At least 250 words of visible text
word_count.principle: Thin pages give search and answer engines little to understand or quote.
word_count.fix: Add genuinely useful text (descriptions, answers), never filler.

author_attribution.title: Author is attributed
author_attribution.principle: Clear authorship is a core credibility signal for search and AI answers.
author_attribution.fix: Add <meta name="author"> and author/Person in JSON-LD.

llms_txt.title: llms.txt published (optional discovery aid)
llms_txt.principle: llms.txt is a proposed convention, not a ranking factor. It is a cheap, plain-language map for AI tools.
llms_txt.fix: Publish /llms.txt with a short summary and key links.

ai_crawlers_allowed.title: AI search crawlers are not blocked
ai_crawlers_allowed.principle: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini can only cite pages their crawlers may read.
ai_crawlers_allowed.fix: Do not disallow the AI search user-agents in robots.txt.

lang.title: <html lang> set
lang.principle: Screen readers and translators need the page language.

img_alt.title: Images have descriptive alt text
img_alt.principle: Alt text is read aloud to blind visitors and used by search engines to understand images.
img_alt.fix: Describe the image (e.g. 'Fearlessly Unfuckwithable by Kay Joy Flowers, book cover').

link_text.title: Links have discernible text
link_text.principle: Screen-reader users navigate by link text.
link_text.fix: Give every link visible text or an aria-label.

skip_link.title: Skip-to-content link
skip_link.principle: Keyboard users shouldn't have to tab through the menu on every page.
skip_link.fix: Add a visually hidden 'Skip to content' link targeting <main id="main">.

img_dimensions.title: Images declare width and height
img_dimensions.principle: Without dimensions the layout jumps as images load (Cumulative Layout Shift).
img_dimensions.fix: Add width and height attributes matching the aspect ratio.

lcp_not_lazy.title: Hero image is not lazy-loaded
lcp_not_lazy.principle: The largest above-the-fold image is usually the Largest Contentful Paint. Lazy-loading it delays LCP.
lcp_not_lazy.fix: Remove loading="lazy" from the first image and add fetchpriority="high".

html_weight.title: HTML under 100 KB
html_weight.principle: Small HTML parses fast on mobile networks.
html_weight.fix: Move repeated inline code into shared files.

checkout_links_ok.title: Checkout links resolve
checkout_links_ok.principle: A broken checkout link is a lost sale.
checkout_links_ok.fix: Replace with the current Beacons or Stripe link.

hero_cta.title: Clear call to action in the first screen
hero_cta.principle: Visitors decide in seconds. The first section should offer the next step.
hero_cta.fix: Add a primary button in the hero.

nav_complete.title: Footer links to every main section
nav_complete.principle: Consistent footers give a second path to offers and to the privacy policy.
nav_complete.fix: Use the same footer links on every public page.
